# AI Development On-Ramp

`suretylabs/ai-dev-onramp` is a public, AI-guided operational context system
for moving an experienced developer into a GitHub-centered Windows, VS Code,
Copilot, and modern Python workflow. It contains the canonical runtime
contract, procedural guides, mental-model visuals, reusable templates, and
stack references. Use the runtime entrypoint below when the user explicitly
mounts this repository as read-only context.

## Runtime entrypoint

- [CONTEXT_LAYER.md](CONTEXT_LAYER.md) - authoritative activation, mode,
  loading, handshake, failure, and transition contract.

## Core material

- [Guiding LLM contract](guides/00-guiding-llm-contract.md)
- [Repository README](README.md)
- [Guide index](guides/README.md)
- [Visual index](visuals/README.md)
- [Template index](templates/README.md)
- [Reference index](reference/README.md)
- [Context-layer validation protocol](docs/CONTEXT_LAYER_VALIDATION.md)

`llms.txt` is an index for tools that support this convention. It is not a
universal discovery or activation mechanism. `CONTEXT_LAYER.md` is authoritative
for runtime activation.
